title: Caitiff Staff

sources.title: Caitiff's Restoration
markers: | summary = '''Caitiff's Restoration''' is a class action granted by the [[Caitiff Staff]] that allows the wielder to recover a [[Warlock]] spell slot.

summary: A +2 quarterstaff that boosts spell attacks and save DC by 1 and can restore a Warlock slot.

fields.Caitiff’s Restoration: Action once per Long Rest. Replenish one expended Warlock spell slot.
fields.Base value: 190 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Arcane Enchantment: +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Expanded the card from the pinned item and linked gameplay evidence.
